info.title: assembly-rewriter: a dotnet tool to rewrite assembly namespaces

options.name: --in
options.description: [repeatable] Input path for assembly to rewrite. Use multiple flags for multiple input paths. [min-count: 1]

options.name: --out
options.description: [repeatable] Output path for rewritten assembly. Use multiple flags for multiple output paths. [min-count: 1]

options.name: --resolvedir
options.description: [repeatable] Additional assembly resolve directories. Use multiple flags for multiple resolve directories. [default: null]

options.name: --keyfile
options.description: Sign rewritten assembly with this key file. When merge option is specified, the merged assembly will be signed. [default: null]

options.name: --merge
options.description: Merge all rewritten assemblies into a single assembly using the first output path as target.
